notes: Complete, verbatim copy of ODK Central's official OpenAPI 3.0 document (getodk/central-backend docs/api.yaml). Whole published API; no subsetting or renaming. Known inaccuracy inherited from the upstream document: the OData submission-table response (GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/forms/{xmlFormId}.svc/{table}) types a row with the fields of the docs' own `simple` demo form and marks `age` and `name` required. Submission columns are defined by each form's XForm definition, so no other form's rows can satisfy it; traffic from any real form will report those two as missing.
